itemFacts.academy-guide: Instruction/reference material; network access to academy.claude.com when following links; no bundled executable.
itemFacts.algorithmic-art: p5.js browser runtime and caller-owned browser/CDN access for templates; no browser launched by Apply.
itemFacts.brand-guidelines: Instruction material; caller supplies the actual design/document tools and fonts.
itemFacts.canvas-design: Python 3 with Pillow/reportlab for rendering; supplied fonts remain under their adjacent OFL notices and root third-party notices. No rendering in material Apply.
itemFacts.claude-api: Caller chooses Python anthropic SDK, TypeScript @anthropic-ai/sdk or another documented language SDK; current compatible SDK, network and host-owned ANTHROPIC_API_KEY/account required. No SDK/account acquisition or model call.
itemFacts.discernment-nudge: Instruction material; harness reasoning/response behavior is client-owned and unobserved.
itemFacts.frontend-design: Instruction material; project-selected frontend runtime/build/browser tools remain caller-owned.
itemFacts.internal-comms: Instruction/examples; caller-owned communication context, no message transport or send operation.
itemFacts.mcp-builder: Skill/reference material, not an MCP server or registration. Python 3 with mcp>=1.1.0, anthropic>=0.39.0 in scripts/requirements.txt for evaluation.py/mcp_client.py. Caller owns endpoint, transport, credentials and model/account consent; no server or model call.
itemFacts.skill-creator: Python 3, PyYAML for validation/packaging; eval/improvement scripts additionally require available Claude CLI, caller-approved account/model calls and caller-owned eval fixtures. render_review.py needs browser for viewing only; no eval/model execution.
itemFacts.slack-gif-creator: Python 3 with Pillow, imageio and numpy, plus compatible imageio-ffmpeg/FFmpeg when chosen; caller acquires packages/tools under their own licenses. Complete scripts and requirements retained.
itemFacts.theme-factory: Instruction/themes and theme-showcase PDF delivered; caller supplies document/design renderer.
itemFacts.web-artifacts-builder: Bash, Node/npm and pnpm for scripts/init-artifact.sh and bundle-artifact.sh; frontend packages and network acquisition remain caller-owned. No install/build/browser launched.
itemFacts.webapp-testing: Python >=3.9 as Catalog compatible prerequisite; scripts/with_server.py uses only stdlib. Actual browser automation additionally needs compatible playwright Python package and separately acquired browser binaries, a caller-owned local application and approved command. No server or browser started by material Apply.
